description: This PHP source file implements the web interface and client-side scripting for MTA (Multimedia Terminal Adapter) Line Diagnostics within a gateway configuration page. It includes HTML, embedded PHP for dynamic content, JavaScript for user interactions and AJAX requests, and server-side PHP includes for header, navigation, and footer components.

methods.name: start_diagnostics1
methods.description: JavaScript event handler that initiates diagnostics for MTA Line 1, including AJAX requests and user confirmation if the line is Off-Hook.

methods.name: start_diagnostics2
methods.description: JavaScript event handler that initiates diagnostics for MTA Line 2, including AJAX requests and user confirmation if the line is Off-Hook.
